t: What Marine Habitat Database Is All About
title: What Marine Habitat Database Is All About
description: Marine habitats are ocean neighborhoods: coral reefs (0.1% of ocean, 25% of marine species), kelp forests, seagrass meadows (blue carbon sinks), and deep-sea vents. Disturbance — bleaching (Great Barrier Reef: mass events 2016-2022), trawling, runoff — degrades them; MPAs (marine protected areas) let them recover. Map the habitat, measure the community, protect what works.
